online_source_facts_recorded: HF model page lists License: apache-2.0 and shows Transformers/Safetensors tags.
HF model card demonstrates AutoTokenizer and AutoModelForCausalLM loading for TinyLlama.
HF model card says TinyLlama adopted the same architecture and tokenizer as Llama 2 and needs transformers>=4.34.

HF files page shows the selected repo is about 2.2 GB and includes config.json, generation_config.json, model.safetensors, tokenizer.json, tokenizer.model, tokenizer_config.json, and special_tokens_map.json.
Transformers installation docs say Transformers works with PyTorch and has been tested on Python 3.10+ and PyTorch 2.4+.
Transformers installation docs say offline/firewalled use requires files downloaded and cached ahead of time, and points to snapshot_download.
Hugging Face Hub docs say hf_hub_download caches files on disk in a version-aware way; snapshot_download downloads all files at a specified revision.
Transformers generation docs define max_new_tokens/min_new_tokens and the generation controls that must be pinned for exact decode length.
Transformers attention backend docs describe AttentionInterface registration and mask-interface behavior, motivating a live Llama surface probe before capture.
Transformers KV cache docs distinguish DynamicCache/StaticCache/QuantizedCache and show cache choice is part of generation semantics.
PyTorch SDPA docs define scaled_dot_product_attention over query/key/value, optional mask, and dropout, which remains the dense semantic baseline.
vLLM PagedAttention literature and docs emphasize KV-cache memory/layout effects, so named-hardware timing must include cache layout and serving-style baselines.
Hugging Face snapshot_download is revision-addressed and cached, supporting exact snapshot materialization before trace capture.
Transformers docs expose attn_implementation and default SDPA behavior, supporting explicit eager attention for trace extraction.
Transformers generation docs support exact min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens plus greedy single-beam controls for cached decode coverage.

Transformers attention backend docs state backend-specific mask conventions differ: eager uses a float mask added to scores, while SDPA/Flash/Flex consume other mask forms, so backend identity is semantically material.
PyTorch SDPA docs define its fused scaled-dot-product path over Q/K/V with optional masks/dropout; this is a dense baseline, not the capture hook surface.
Transformers KV-cache docs distinguish cache classes and compile/offload characteristics, so timing later must report cache strategy rather than only attention sparsity.
Hugging Face Hub docs state snapshot_download is revision-addressed and cached, and allow_patterns can restrict files.
Current huggingface_hub source exposes dry_run=True returning DryRunFileInfo objects for snapshot_download.
The selected TinyLlama commit tree shows the required files and 2.2 GB model.safetensors payload under the locked tree.
Hugging Face download docs describe local_dir and allow_patterns, supporting an explicit local snapshot intake path.
Hugging Face cache docs describe HF_HUB_CACHE/HF_HOME and snapshots layout, supporting local snapshot/cache probes.
Transformers attention backend docs describe attn_implementation in from_pretrained, supporting explicit eager trace capture.
Transformers tokenizer docs describe tokenizers as model input preparation and distinguish fast/Rust and Python implementations, so the trace records tokenizer surface facts.

Transformers chat-template docs warn that adding special tokens after applying a chat template can duplicate tokens; this trace explicitly records that no chat template is applied and add_special_tokens=True is intentional raw-prompt tokenization.
Hugging Face snapshot_download supports allow_patterns/local_dir and dry-run planning, so snapshot materialization can be audited separately from capture runtime.
The selected TinyLlama safetensors file has a published 2.2 GB payload and SHA256 digest, supporting material integrity checks.
Safetensors headers can be parsed independently of tensor buffers, supporting import-light local snapshot validation.
Rev0130: structural safetensors header validation is not enough for capture readiness; the pinned model.safetensors SHA-256 must be checked before model load.
Rev0130: snapshot download/materialization and 2.2GB hash verification must use a snapshot-specific timeout, not the short generic probe timeout.
Rev0133: a digest-verified cache candidate is not sufficient; the capture helper must prove its own --model load source is the digest-verified local snapshot path.
Rev0133: local_files_only=True plus explicit local directory loading closes HF cache-resolution ambiguity during evidence capture.
Rev0137: official Transformers docs show local_files_only=True with a local directory, reinforcing that selected local snapshot identity must drive loader and replay receipts.
Rev0137: Hugging Face Hub download docs describe revision-aware local cache paths, reinforcing that preflight evidence must bind concrete bytes rather than mutable labels.
Rev0137: safetensors documentation describes safe metadata/header parsing but not weight authenticity, so the harness treats SHA-256 byte digests as the replay root.
Hugging Face Hub docs say full-length commit hashes are required when downloading from a specific commit revision.
Hugging Face Hub docs describe snapshot_download at a given revision plus allow_patterns/local_dir/dry-run, supporting a small external runner that materializes only reviewed files.

Transformers attention backend docs say attn_implementation selects the attention function and warn that custom attention implementations must register matching mask handling, which supports keeping eager trace semantics separate from SDPA/Flash timing baselines.
SLSA verification guidance emphasizes inspecting provenance against expectations; CloudtainerML receipts should therefore verify subject digests rather than merely carry them.

Recent agentic artifact-evaluation research reports generated reproduction scripts and found artifact/paper errors, reinforcing that the next step should be executable runner packets over more doctrine.
